data.title: Offer to make your fixed-term job permanent
data.summary: Beispiel Pflegeheim am Park gGmbH offers to continue your fixed-term contract as a nurse (Pflegefachkraft) permanently from 1 July 2027, full-time, on unchanged terms. They ask for your decision within 6 working days of the letter date (16 April 2027).
data.explanation: Your current fixed-term contract ends on 30 June 2027. Your employer offers to continue it without an end date from 1 July 2027, with the same conditions and full-time hours. They ask for your answer within 6 working days (Werktage, Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays) counted from the letter date; the app shows the deadline. If you don't answer in time, they plan to fill the position otherwise. Decide whether to accept and reply to the employer in good time. If you are unsure, consider getting advice, for example from a union or works council.

items.title: Reply to permanent contract offer
items.action: Tell your employer whether you accept the offer to continue your employment permanently from 1 July 2027.
items.consequence: The employer plans to fill the position otherwise.
